apps.name: Resume Analyzer
apps.tagline: AI-powered resume analysis with ATS scoring and actionable feedback.
apps.description: Analyze resumes against job descriptions using AI to identify ATS compatibility, missing skills, and tailored recommendations for improvement.
apps.purpose: To help job seekers optimize their resumes before applying for internships and full-time positions.
apps.target: Students, fresh graduates, and professionals preparing job applications.
apps.howItWorks: Upload or paste a resume together with a job description. The AI evaluates the resume, highlights strengths and weaknesses, provides an ATS score, and suggests improvements.
apps.author: Jasper Rosales

apps.name: CV Builder
apps.tagline: Build ATS-friendly resumes with live editing and PDF export.
apps.description: A modern CV builder featuring drag-and-drop sections, real-time preview, customizable templates, and PDF export—all without requiring an account.
apps.purpose: To simplify professional resume creation while ensuring ATS compatibility.
apps.target: Students, job seekers, and professionals updating their resumes.
apps.howItWorks: Fill in your information, rearrange resume sections, preview changes instantly, and export your CV as a professionally formatted PDF.
apps.author: Jasper Rosales

apps.name: Invoice Generator
apps.tagline: Create, manage, and export professional invoices effortlessly.
apps.description: A secure invoice management platform built with Next.js that enables freelancers and businesses to generate printable invoices with PDF export.
apps.purpose: To provide a simple yet professional solution for invoice creation and management.
apps.howItWorks: Enter client and invoice details, customize items and pricing, preview the invoice, and export it as a high-quality PDF.
apps.author: Jasper Rosales

apps.name: Portfolio X
apps.tagline: A technical portfolio showcasing software engineering expertise.
apps.description: A personal portfolio highlighting projects, skills, achievements, and technical experience with a modern responsive interface.
apps.purpose: To serve as a professional portfolio for employers and collaborators.
apps.howItWorks: Browse featured projects, technical skills, certifications, and contact information in a responsive portfolio.
apps.author: Jasper Rosales

apps.name: Digital Showcase
apps.tagline: A centralized platform for showcasing achievements and announcements.
apps.description: A digital showcase for displaying organizational achievements, projects, and announcements in a clean and accessible interface.
apps.purpose: To highlight accomplishments and important updates for organizations and students.
apps.howItWorks: Browse categorized achievements, announcements, and featured projects from different organizations.
apps.author: Jasper Rosales
